title: Implement the engine + tool part of the INBOX feature in the Rust workspace at /home/n3o/code/aura-harness. Read the fu…
summary: The threading, the mail observer and the `send_to_agent` subject are all in place, and the three crates compile with their tests (`cargo test -p aura-engine -p aura-exec-tools -p aura-exec-traits --no-run`). But I ran out of time before running the tests, clippy or rustfmt, and I did not write the host-level tests (item 8). Nothing is committed.
